metadata.description: Whitelisted source IP addresses allowed to connect to ActiveMQ
Log Analytics workspace retention in days

rules.name: Allow-ActiveMQ-OpenWire-Whitelisted
rules.description: Forward TCP 61616 (OpenWire) from whitelisted IPs to ActiveMQ

rules.name: Allow-ActiveMQ-WebConsole-Whitelisted
rules.description: Forward TCP 8161 (Web Console) from whitelisted IPs to ActiveMQ

rules.name: Allow-ActiveMQ-STOMP-Whitelisted
rules.description: Forward TCP 61613 (STOMP) from whitelisted IPs to ActiveMQ

rules.name: Allow-ACA-DNS
rules.description: Allow DNS resolution from Container Apps

rules.name: Allow-ACA-HTTPS-Outbound
rules.description: Allow HTTPS outbound for container image pulls

rules.name: Allow-DNAT-ActiveMQ-Translated
rules.description: Explicit allow for DNAT translated traffic to ACA (ActiveMQ ports)

rules.name: Deny-All
rules.description: Deny all other traffic (explicit deny for logging)

containers.name: activemq
command: sed -i '/<transportConnector name="openwire"/d' /opt/activemq/conf/activemq.xml && sed -i 's|<transportConnector name="stomp" uri="stomp://0.0.0.0:61613.*"/>|<transportConnector name="stomp" uri="stomp://0.0.0.0:61616?transport.closeAsync=false"/>|' /opt/activemq/conf/activemq.xml && /opt/activemq/bin/activemq console

content.json:
# 🔥 ActiveMQ Firewall Traffic Workbook
Interactive workbook for troubleshooting denied traffic and monitoring ActiveMQ access patterns through Azure Firewall.

## ❌ Denied Connections
Connections blocked by Azure Firewall network rules. Use this to identify misconfigurations, missing whitelist entries, or attack attempts.

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "AzureFirewallNetworkRule"
| where msg_s has "Deny"
| summarize DenyCount=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| render timechart
content.title: Denied Connections Over Time

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "AzureFirewallNetworkRule"
| where msg_s has "Deny"
| extend SourceIP = extract(@"from (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)", 1, msg_s)
| extend DestPort = extract(@":(\d+)\.", 1, msg_s)
| summarize DenyCount=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by SourceIP, DestPort
| order by DenyCount desc
| take 50
content.title: Top Denied Source IPs & Ports

content.json:
## ✅ Allowed DNAT Connections
Successful connections forwarded by DNAT rules to ActiveMQ.

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "AzureFirewallNatRule"
| summarize AllowCount=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| render timechart
content.title: DNAT Forwarded Connections Over Time

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "AzureFirewallNatRule"
| extend SourceIP = extract(@"from (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)", 1, msg_s)
| extend OrigDest = extract(@"to (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+:\d+)", 1, msg_s)
| extend TranslatedDest = extract(@"translated to (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+:\d+)", 1, msg_s)
| summarize HitCount=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by SourceIP, OrigDest, TranslatedDest
| order by HitCount desc
| take 50
content.title: DNAT Rule Hits - Source → Original → Translated

content.json:
## 🔍 Recent Denied Traffic (Raw Logs)
Detailed denied connection logs for troubleshooting.

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "AzureFirewallNetworkRule"
| where msg_s has "Deny"
| project TimeGenerated, msg_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Recent Denied Connections (Raw)

settings.content:
# 🔥 ActiveMQ Firewall Traffic Dashboard
**Azure Firewall** → Denied & Allowed traffic to ActiveMQ on Azure Container Apps

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "AzureFirewallNetworkRule"
| where msg_s has "Deny"
| extend SourceIP = extract(@"from (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)", 1, msg_s)
| extend DestPort = extract(@":(\d+)\.", 1, msg_s)
| summarize DenyCount=count() by SourceIP, DestPort
| order by DenyCount desc
| take 20

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "AzureFirewallNatRule"
| extend SourceIP = extract(@"from (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)", 1, msg_s)
| extend DestPort = extract(@":(\d+)$", 1, msg_s)
| summarize AllowCount=count() by SourceIP, DestPort
| order by AllowCount desc
| take 20

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "AzureFirewallNetworkRule"
| where msg_s has "Deny"
| summarize DenyCount=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| render timechart with (title="Denied Connections Over Time")

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category in ("AzureFirewallNetworkRule", "AzureFirewallNatRule")
| extend Action = iif(msg_s has "Deny", "Deny", "Allow")
| extend DestPort = extract(@":(\d+)[\s\.]", 1, msg_s)
| where isnotempty(DestPort)
| summarize Count=count() by DestPort, Action
| order by Count desc
| take 20
